title: Weekly marketing report
summary: Each week, compares marketing metrics with the week before, audits a few key pages, and flags big moves.

inspiration.title: AI marketing report (GA, Google Ads, Meta Ads)
On-page SEO audit of any website

stages.title: Read both weeks
stages.does: Reads this week's and last week's totals per source and metric.

stages.title: Compare weeks
stages.does: Computes the change per source and metric, so no figure is the model's arithmetic.

stages.title: Audit key pages
stages.does: Opens each page to audit and notes visible issues.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Analytics and ad platforms
connectors.purpose: Read weekly totals per source and metric.
alternatives: Two JSON exports placed in the run folder
connectors.connect: Add an MCP server or connector that reads your analytics and ad platforms. RoutineOS does not supply one.

connectors.label: Web fetch
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run can already open web pages.
